run.researchNotes: Top-up 3, 16 Nov 2026, 2 further searches. competition.players: every row is now restated on one measure, share of scheduled commercial bank credit, and one date, end-March 2026 (31 Mar 2026). The three bank-GROUP rows replace their Dec 2025 values with RBI's Annual BSR-1 March 2026 (released 29 May 2026): PSBs 52.9%, private banks 39.4%, others 7.7% (residual). This also supersedes the 59.45% PSB figure in top-up 2, which was gross advances including overseas books. The eleven bank rows are each bank's reported advances at 31 Mar 2026 divided by RBI Section-42 SCB bank credit of Rs 2,13,61,435 cr. Most use global or gross advances and so are modestly overstated against the domestic BSR group shares; for example, the named PSBs sum to above their group's share once overseas books are counted. Group rows are totals that overlap the bank rows; read them separately and do not add them to the bank rows. global.cagr y15, y10 and y3 remain unestablished. McKinsey gives banking revenue of $1.8tn in 2000 and $6.5tn in 2024 (5.4% CAGR over 24 years) and 4.6% for 2023-24. However, its 2026 review restates 2024 at $6.1tn, so the series is not consistent. No published 2010, 2015 or 2022 value on the 2025 basis ($6.4tn) was found. A 15-, 10- or 3-year CAGR would therefore mix bases, so these keys are omitted.

players.name: State Bank of India
players.basis: share of scheduled commercial bank credit, end-March 2026
players.source: CALCULATION: Gross advances (whole bank incl. foreign offices), 31 Mar 2026: Rs 49,32,627 cr - SBI FY26 results / RBI bank credit Rs 2,13,61,435 cr
players.moat: Largest deposit franchise (~22% share) and branch network; lowest-cost government and salary flows; FY26 ROE 18.57%.
players.whyLeader: Scale plus sovereign trust held share through the 2015-2020 NPA clean-up; FY26 gross advances +16.87%.
